name: File Copy
install_when: only for accounts on the [Full Access] privilege set

Close | script 75 "Cancel Picker" | closes the Picker window after setting Picker::Results to a "canceled" result
custom item "Development Mode" | script 76 "Development Mode" | goes to the Contact Picker layout, installs [Standard FileMaker Menus] as the file default, shows toolbars and resizes the window (developer unlock)
open_question: The DDR lists only kept items, so omitted File commands are unknown. Compared with karbon_LedgerLink "Standard File" (same base menu), this menu lacks: Create New..., Open..., Show Hosts..., submenu [Open Recent], submenu [Open Favorite], submenu [Manage], submenu [Sharing], File Options..., Change Password..., Page Setup..., Print..., submenu [Import Records], Export Records..., submenu [Save/Send Records As], submenu [Send], Save a Copy As..., Recover.... The whole File menu installs only for [Full Access]. Do other accounts get no File menu (and no Close shortcut), or is this meant to hide only the Development Mode item?
